paper.title: Evolving Excellence: Automated Optimization of LLM-based Agents
paper.central_claim: Artemis通过语义进化与自动组件发现，联合优化异构agent的prompt、工具说明、模型和参数，以较少人工干预提高性能或效率，改动可在未来部署留存。

reason: 完整版本正文和全部附录已读；配置种群根据执行反馈变异、筛选并保存，属于非权重harness闭环。
rationale: 配置优化有多任务实例与成本收益，但缺简单搜索及模块消融；CrewAI省token伴准确率下降且评分prompt也变，留出互斥与完整搜索成本未明。

sections_read: All appendix configuration/prompt and code examples including Figures 11–14

evidence.quote: Artemis automatically analyzes the codebase structure to identify optimizable components such as prompts, tool descriptions, model parameters, and execution settings.
evidence.support_explanation: 非权重配置是更新对象；架构无关不等于不需代码访问。

evidence.quote:
Uses Bayesian optimization to find optimal
combinations when components interact. Explores the combinatorial space of
component versions to identify synergistic configurations.
evidence.support_explanation: 局部组件GA之后组合版本的具体设计。

evidence.quote:
LLM ensembles perform mutations and crossovers on components,
with hierarchical evaluation using cheap filters (LLM scoring) before
expensive validation (benchmark execution).
evidence.support_explanation: 变异交叉及便宜代理/贵执行层次评估，未给代理排序审计。

evidence.quote:
Performance improvements achieved
through optimization persist across future deployments of the optimized
configuration.
evidence.support_explanation: 作者声称配置保留到未来部署；这是架构/持久化陈述而非独立留出证明。

evidence.quote: During the optimisation process, we extract a subset of 50 problems from the benchmark as the validation set, select the configuration achieving the best metric performance, and then evaluate this selected version against the baseline on a larger set of 300 problems
evidence.support_explanation: 选择50及报告300有区分，未明确互斥。

evidence.quote: Across three repeated runs on the evaluation set, the optimised agent achieves an average completion rate of 0.917 versus 0.796 for the baseline (+15.2%) and an average accuracy of 0.81 versus 0.59 (+37.3%).
evidence.support_explanation: 作者报告重复评估改善，但非三个独立搜索种子。

evidence.quote:
baseline (0.660), prompt optimization (0.750), and search optimization
(0.722).

Statistical significance patterns reveal important insights: improvements were statistically significant (p < 0.05) for Mini-SWE, CrewAI’s cost reduction, and MathTales-Teacher (both accuracy and completeness, p < 0.001), while ALE improvements, though substantial, did not reach significance (p = 0.10)
evidence.support_explanation: 不把ALE结果宣称显著；存在统计检验但未跨搜索重复。

evidence.quote:
The optimization completed in 9 hours across three generations with
a population size of 3.
Token count tracks total tokens (input + output) across two API requests per problem; one for the researcher agent solving the problem and one for the reporting analyst agent evaluating correctness.
evidence.support_explanation: 两个API请求均计token，评分由reporting analyst完成。

evidence.quote: In this case, Artemis modified each prompt and set reasonable token limits. The result is that problems with exceptional expense are intentionally failed at zero expense.
evidence.support_explanation: 省成本包含主动放弃昂贵问题，不是无损推理提升。

evidence.quote: The 50×6 evaluation of the same optimized configuration gives a consistent picture: a 36.9% reduction in mean tokens (7590), a 36.2% reduction in median tokens, and an accuracy of 0.78 (-4.9%, p
evidence.support_explanation: 补充设计仍是同配置，非优化器独立重复。

evidence.quote:
While the complete Artemis platform setup cannot be shared, the provided code allows practitioners to examine our agent implementations and verify the reported performance
improvements.
evidence.support_explanation: agent代码承诺不等于完整优化器可复现。

evidence.quote: locally and does not rely on any commercial models; hence, we do not consider token usage or cost in our experiments.
evidence.support_explanation: MathTales没有商业API不等于没有硬件/搜索成本。

evidence.quote:
671.7 total hours across all optimization experiments, representing substantial
resource investment.
evidence.support_explanation: 上游优化成本不能用部署单次成本替代。

evidence.quote:
Both ALE and Mini-SWE started with generic,
underspecified configurations.
evidence.support_explanation: 对照头部空间较大，不能证明胜过强替代优化器。

evidence.quote: Our primary contribution is the design and evaluation of a general-purpose optimization platform that integrates ideas such as semantic prompt evolution, evolutionary improvement, and benchmark-driven fitness evaluation into a cohesive system for practical agent tuning.
evidence.support_explanation: 作者也承认整合平台；最近邻残余需按整合和可操作性限定。
优化后的配置含评分agent角色；与每prompt修改及双调用测量合读，存在评价通道同时变动的未隔离风险，非声称发生作弊。

signatures.object: agent配置组件版本与候选种群（prompt、工具说明、模型选择、温度/阈值等）
signatures.information: 上传代码、目标、用户benchmark、执行日志、候选fitness及谱系
signatures.operation: 自动定位可优化组件→LLM语义变异/交叉→便宜代理筛选→执行benchmark→局部GA选优→Bayesian组合版本
signatures.output: 获选配置、候选版本和可部署修改
signatures.conditions: 可运行benchmark、目标/fitness定义稳定、代理筛选与真实执行排序一致
signatures.feedback: benchmark分数、token及运行日志；部分先用LLM评分
signatures.selection_rule: 局部GA和全局Bayesian选组合，按目标metric保留好版本；多数阈值/超参未披露
signatures.selection_data: 各领域benchmark或小验证子集；MathTales50题参与选优
signatures.persistence: 版本/谱系及选中配置留存，不训练基座权重
signatures.later_use: 重新部署选中配置，MathTales在300题评价；互斥性未明
signatures.claimed_effect: 跨框架质量/成本改进，减少手工调参
signatures.failure_boundary: 初始化差异、代理漂移、评测prompt共同更新、优化成本、无确定留出边界

gap.author_gap: 孤立prompt/工作流优化难联合调整异构系统组件；需要架构无关、少人工配置优化平台。
gap.checked_gap: 多类型组件发现和版本组合是具体工程问题；现有语义prompt进化与agent搜索已很接近，本文没有实测更优搜索机制而主要展示集成平台。
